title: Submit an idea
subtitle: Multi-Users in Middle-earth
intro: Submit one distinct idea per form
Submitting does not imply acceptance. Ideas may be modified, combined with other proposals, or declined after review
Use your best judgement. You are not expected to know how MUME is implemented internally

fields.label: Give your idea a short, clear title
fields.help: Make it immediately clear what the proposal is about.
fields.placeholder: Stablehands hold mounts overnight in Bree

fields.label: What is the primary purpose of this idea?
fields.help: Choose the one option that best captures the main reason for the proposal.

options.label: Solve a problem or frustration
options.description: Something confusing, inconvenient, frustrating, broken, or otherwise detracting from play.

options.label: Add a missing feature
options.description: A feature, activity, system, or capability MUME does not currently offer.

options.label: Improve the newbie experience
options.description: Makes MUME easier to understand, enter, learn, or navigate for new or returning players.

options.label: Address a balance concern
options.description: Balance between classes, races, sides, strategies, equipment, rewards, or other gameplay elements.

options.label: Improve or extend an existing mechanic
options.description: Builds on, expands, revises, or adds new uses to something that already exists.

options.label: Improve quality of life
options.description: Reduces friction, repetitive work, or confusion without substantially changing core gameplay.

options.label: Improve lore or immersion
options.description: Atmosphere, world consistency, Tolkien fidelity, roleplay, or the sense of being in Middle-earth.

options.label: Add something enjoyable or interesting
options.description: Variety, replayability, flavour, or optional activity that makes the game more engaging.

options.label: Other
options.description: The idea does not fit the categories above.

fields.label: Describe your proposal
fields.help: Explain the change clearly enough that someone unfamiliar with the idea can understand what would be different.
fields.placeholder: What is the mechanic, feature, change, or content, and how would it work in practice?
guidance: The proposed mechanic, feature, change, or content
How it would work at a practical level
Whether it uses or extends an existing MUME mechanic
One distinct idea only. No implementation-level technical detail needed

fields.label: What would this improve?
fields.help: What problem does it solve, what opportunity does it create, or what should be better for players if it works?
fields.placeholder: What is missing, frustrating, underused, or limited today, and what changes for players.
guidance: What is currently missing, frustrating, underused, confusing, or limited
What player behaviour or experience it is meant to improve
Whether it helps replayability, grouping, exploration, balance, immersion, retention, or the economy
Whether the objective still holds if the exact implementation changes

fields.label: Who might be affected by this idea?
fields.help: Select every player group or style of play that could be meaningfully affected.

options.label: New players
options.description: New to MUME or still learning its systems and world.

options.label: Returning players
options.description: Back after a long absence, relearning systems, commands, or conventions.

options.label: Solo players
options.description: Commonly explore, XP, quest, or travel alone.

options.label: Group players
options.description: Organised or informal groups for XP, quests, SMOBs, or travel.

options.label: PvE-focused players
options.description: Mobs, XP, SMOBs, quests, exploration, or equipment acquisition.

options.label: PK / PvP-focused players
options.description: Player-killing, side balance, escape and chase, combat strategy, scouting, raiding.

options.label: Roleplayers and immersion-focused players
options.description: Lore, descriptions, atmosphere, communication, or roleplay systems.

options.label: Most or all players
options.description: Broad enough that nearly everyone would encounter or benefit from it.

options.label: Other
options.description: Another player group not represented above.

fields.label: What parts of MUME might be affected?
fields.help: Select every system, content area, or gameplay element that may need to be considered.

options.label: XP and progression
options.description: Levelling, practice points, training, advancement, rerolls.

options.label: PK and PvP
options.description: Player combat, war points, side balance, raiding, escape, tracking.

options.label: Combat, skills and spells
options.description: Mechanics, abilities, saves, damage, status effects.

options.label: Economy and equipment
options.description: Gold, shops, item value, sinks, durability, rare gear.

options.label: Mobs and objects
options.description: Mobile behaviour, stats, drops, object properties and interactions.

options.label: Quests
options.description: Structure, rewards, objectives, dialogue, tokens, repeatability.

options.label: SMOBs and group encounters
options.description: Encounter design, group difficulty, phases, rewards.

options.label: Zones and world content
options.description: Rooms, travel routes, hidden areas, geography, zone activity.

options.label: Newbie systems
options.description: Newbie areas, onboarding, tutorials, starter gear, early guidance.

options.label: Commands and interface
options.description: Syntax, prompts, output, information presentation, mmapper, usability.

options.label: Helpfiles and documentation
options.description: Written guidance, terminology, examples, discoverability.

options.label: Lore, descriptions and immersion
options.description: Room and mob descriptions, naming, consistency, flavour text.

options.label: Social and group formation
options.description: Group finding, communication, incentives to group, cooperation.

options.label: Other
options.description: Another system or content area not listed.

fields.label: Estimate the likely impact
fields.help: How broadly could the change affect MUME? This is only your best estimate.

options.label: Limited
options.description: Affects a narrow situation, area, mechanic, or relatively small number of players.

options.label: Moderate
options.description: Noticeably affects a playstyle, region, player group, or recurring part of the game.

options.label: Major
options.description: Game-wide effects, or significant effects on balance, strategy, progression, PK, or the economy.

fields.label: Additional details or examples
fields.help: Optional. Anything that helps reviewers understand or evaluate the proposal.
fields.placeholder: Precedents, helpfiles, logs, lore references, or examples of the problem.
guidance: Existing MUME mechanics that set a precedent, or related content that could be reused
Logs or gameplay examples of the problem
Similar mechanics elsewhere in MUME, or in other games
